P.name: Reign of Anger
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renekton's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|5 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses {{as|1 Fury}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

Entering combat or using an attack will stop the {{as|Fury}} loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while ''{{ai|Dominus|Renekton}}'' is active, the timer is continuously refreshed.
P.description2: While '''Renekton''' has at least {{as|50 Fury}}, his next {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, excluding ''{{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton|Slice}}'', consumes {{as|50 Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate {{as|Fury}}.
P.description3: '''Renekton''' generates {{as|50% '''bonus''' Fury}} from all sources while {{as|below 50% of his '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Cull the Meek
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' cleaves around himself, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for each enemy hit, up to a cap.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Champion Healing|{{ap|12 to 44}} {{as|(+ 17% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Enhanced Champion Healing|{{ap|36 to 132}} {{as|(+ 51% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: '''Renekton''' generates {{tip|fury|{{as|{{fd|2.5}} Fury}}}} for each non-champion hit and {{as|10 Fury}} for each champion hit, up to {{as|30|Fury}} total per cast.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Cull the Meek'' has increased damage, tripled '''total''' healing, and a quadrupled healing cap.
Q.description5: '''''Renekton''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} or {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.''

W.name: Ruthless Predator
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have a {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second cast time|(Estimated)}}, have {{sti|range|175 range}} and strike the target twice, dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and generates {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates {{as|10 '''bonus''' Fury}}.
W.leveling: {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5*2 to 65*2}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}}|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 75% AD)}}}}
W.description2: ''Ruthless Predator's'' first strike can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Renekton|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target upon the first strike if they are not a {{tip|monster}}, as well as increasing the {{tip|stun}} duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Ruthless Predator {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Renekton's''' basic attack timer. After Ruthless Predator's standard and empowered attack cast time, '''Renekton''' cannot move nor cast {{ai|Cull the Meek|Renekton}} or {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} for {{rutngt|0.525}}. Casting {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} ends this lockout prematurely.''

E.name: Slice and Dice
E.description: {{sbc|Active - Slice:}} '''Renekton''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through.
E.description2: If '''Renekton''' hits an enemy, he can recast ''Slice and Dice'' within the next 4 seconds.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Dice:}} '''Renekton''' repeats the first cast's effects.
E.description4: Both casts generate {{tip|fury|{{as|2 Fury}}}} for each non-champion hit and {{as|10 Fury}} for each champion hit, up to {{as|30|fury}} total per cast.
E.description5: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Dice'', the recast, deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and inflicts {{sti|arpen|{{as|armor reduction}}}} to enemies hit for 4 seconds.
E.leveling5:
{{st|Enhanced Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 250}} {{as|(+ 135% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Enhanced Damage|{{ap|40+70 to 160+250}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:90+135}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|25 to 35}}%|armor}}}}

R.name: Dominus
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}}, 20% increased [[size]], {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and {{tip|fury|{{as|20 Fury}}}}, as well as increasing ''{{ais|Cull the Meek|Renekton}}'' effect radius.
R.description2: During this time, he deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies and generates {{as|5 Fury}} per second, up to a maximum of {{as|75 Fury}}.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30 to 120}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30*30 to 120*30}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
